background_setting: A city street at night during a holiday celebration. Rows of streetlights cast warm pools of light along wet-looking asphalt beneath a pitch-dark sky. Buildings, storefronts, and parked vehicles line both sides of the street, their windows glowing faintly. The atmosphere is festive but tense, with pyrotechnic smoke drifting across the roadway and crowds lingering on the sidewalks. The road ahead recedes into darkness punctuated by the glowing fireworks and distant traffic signals.
